title: fix(sse): improve SSE streaming chunking and framing to handle partial JSON, delimiters, and token/event ordering
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Fixes SSE streaming edge-cases: correctly handles partial JSON payloads split across chunks, enforces explicit event delimiters, and preserves token/event ordering under high-concurrency loads. No API changes; patch is internal and backwards-compatible.
description: Context: Several customers and internal tests hit flakiness in streaming responses where partial JSON objects emitted by the model were split across SSE chunks, leading to invalid JSON at the client. Additional symptoms included stray delimiters (extra newlines) and occasional reordering of token events in high-concurrency paths. This caused downstream parsers (OpenAI-compat wrappers and structured-output consumers) to either error or apply expensive reassembly logic. Motivation: Make streaming robust and compatible with OpenAI-style event framing so SDKs and lightweight clients can rely on correct incremental JSON assembly. Changes in this PR: 1) Implemented a framing buffer in the runtime SSE streamer that accumulates partial JSON tokens and only emits complete JSON objects or well-formed fragments marked with the OpenAI-compatible "event: delta" semantics. 2) Added explicit delimiter normalization to ensure CRLF/LF differences and stray blank events do not surface to consumers. 3) Tightened the token/event ordering by moving sequencing into the socket write path and adding a light-weight per-stream sequence counter to prevent interleaving when multiple coroutines produce tokens concurrently. 4) OpenAI-compat handler updated to prefer incremental "data: {json}\n\n" events and to gracefully handle trailing partials at stream end. 5) Added unit and integration tests that simulate chunked model outputs and high-concurrency generator interleaving. Migration notes: None for API consumers. SDKs can remove local workarounds for partial-json reassembly after this lands. Checklist: - [x] Add framing buffer and delimiter normalization - [x] Update openai-compat handler and tests - [x] Add unit + integration tests covering partial JSON and ordering - [x] Run perf/latency benchmark and ensure <3% regressions on p99 for typical workloads Related: ENG-3742 (streaming stability), ENG-3780 (openai-compat fixes).
